description: t.p spawns a child that parks in a cancel-oblivious wait, aborts it at 50 and joins it. The child is signalled at 200 and returns an error value without ever reaching a checkpoint: a cancel was requested and never acknowledged, so cancellation wins over the return (classify_spawn_completion) and the join observes Cancelled, where the acknowledged child of task-lifecycle-acknowledged-child-keeps-returned-value-001 kept its value.
